items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: I was playing with Morgan, Sam Morgan, all the parts.

ctx.x: We used a bass and a violin. You had that violin there. I don't care, that violin was a leader. He used to lead the band. So I got up, I got up and I said, Nene knew that I could play. Nene said, come on, Come on little baby. Come on little baby. Come on rest me up. Come on rest me up. We get up there and we play. I got up there and I played. Frank was living in the Algeist then. That's Frank at home too, Frank at home too. Frank was living in the Algeist then. Frank said, you look right, you learn how to play…
I was going to ask some more about those early days. Some of the, when you first played in a brass band, did you play snare drum or bass drum most of the time? Snare drum.
